title: Public Business Expectations (PASS 43)
note: Conservative expected OpsIQ behaviour per public-business case, declared BEFORE running the harness. Proven by src/__tests__/execution/real-public-business-shadow-run.db.test.ts. Public signals are unverified; every risk routes to correction/validation, never accusation; growth/tender blocked until internal proof exists; internal financials are missing-data, never fabricated.

expectations.expectedOwnerApproval: for any tender/pricing decision only; the quality correction is manager-level + evidence-gated
expectations.expectedCockpitSummary: Fix the recurring delivery/quality issue with proof before chasing the tender; validate the public complaint against internal data.
expectations.expectedPublicSignalSummary: active; validation required; no live ingestion; raw text hidden; PII stripped; tender is stale/blocked from auto-submit

expectations.expectedOwnerApproval: not required for the process correction (manager-level); no staff discipline
expectations.expectedCockpitSummary: Correct the wait-time/order-accuracy process with proof; the staff-attitude signal is weak → coaching/SOP, never discipline.
expectations.expectedPublicSignalSummary: active; validation required; PII from any raw review stripped; no accusation

expectedBlockedUnsafe: auto spend/discount/pricing change without owner approval
expectations.expectedOwnerApproval: for any pricing change only; support/onboarding correction is manager-level + evidence-gated
expectations.expectedCockpitSummary: Address support/onboarding with proof; pricing is an owner decision blocked until margin is known; conflicting reviews stay conflict-labelled.
expectations.expectedPublicSignalSummary: active; validation required; conflicting signal labelled; no live ingestion

expectations.expectedCockpitSummary: No public risk signals → nothing invented.

conservativeRules: public praise → monitor-only unless an actionable risk exists
public complaint → correction/validation route, not accusation
tender deadline → readiness/missing-data task, never auto-submit (and stale here)
growth opportunity → blocked while quality/capacity/cash are unknown
internal financials unknown → missing-data, never fabricated money/ROI
